summary: Widget gradient-flow-explorer written to src/widgets/gradient-flow-explorer.js. Controls (DOM order 0-9): spectral radius rho (0.5-3, default 1), matrix type (orthogonal | Gaussian), nonlinearity (linear | tanh | ReLU, default tanh), sigma_x (0-3, default 1), H (8/16/32/64, default 32), n_max (20-200, default 100), LSTM path checkbox (on), b_f (-2..8, default 4), spread s (0-2, default 0.5), new random draw button (seed++). Default state: orthogonal rho=1, tanh, sigma_x=1, H=32, n_max=100, seed 1: the vanilla curve falls to 6.7e-3, 3.1e-11, 1.1e-21 at lags 10, 50, 100 while the dashed rho^n line stays at 1 and the LSTM path sits at 0.13 at lag 100. Numbers checked widget vs an independent numpy reimplementation (same mulberry32/Box-Muller stream; numpy QR/SVD/eigvals): default; rho=3 tanh (3.4e0, 2.8e4, 5.4e8); Gaussian+linear (8.8e-1, 6.5e-1, 6.3e-1, sigma_max 1.882, rho-hat 5.956 vs true 5.9556); Gaussian rho=0.5 H=64 n_max=200 sigma_x=0.1 b_f=-2 s=2 (4.2e-4, 1.7e-16, 7.8e-32, LSTM 2.1e-106, horizon 9); ReLU rho=2 H=8 n_max=20 seed 2; ReLU sigma_x=0 (exactly zero message, horizon 1); tanh sigma_x=0 rho=1.5 (equals n*log10 rho: 5.8e1, 6.4e8, 4.1e17); ReLU Gaussian H=16 seed 3 sigma_x=2.5. All agree to the displayed 2 significant digits, including sigma_max, mean phi', horizon, sigma(b_f) and half-life.
changes: Created src/widgets/gradient-flow-explorer.js: main canvas (log10 gradient ratio vs lag, clamped to [-30,30] with triangle markers, vanilla solid blue, dashed rho reference, dotted sigma_max for Gaussian, green LSTM product-of-gates curve), phi' histogram canvas, text readouts, legend, zero-gradient message, English and Chinese strings per the glossary, subscripts rendered with sub elements.
Verified en and zh with widget-test (no errors, screenshots read, 400 px layout clean) and with widget-probe on eight states.
issues: Default-state numbers differ from the module text's planning simulation by a small factor (widget: 6.7e-3, 3.1e-11, 1.1e-21 at lags 10, 50, 100; text: 1.8e-2, 5.5e-11, 5.1e-21) because the PRNG stream order of the planning draw is unknown; same orders of magnitude, and the text itself says other draws change values by a factor of a few. The prose numbers could be updated to the widget's seed-1 values if exact agreement is wanted.

widget-test reports changedOutput=false for sigma_x, the matrix-type select and the LSTM checkbox; these are test artefacts: the test leaves nonlinearity on 'linear' (where sigma_x truly has no effect), cycles selects back to their first option and toggles the checkbox twice. Probe confirms each changes the output.
The estimated rho-hat for the Gaussian matrix is within about 1e-3 relative of the true spectral radius (512 power iterations on a complex-pair spectrum), as the spec intends.
